Helpful information

Frequently asked questions

A few details to help you plan before sending your cab enquiry.

How do I book a cab in Kanyakumari?

Call 93601 01223 or use the enquiry form. Share your pickup, destination, date, passenger count and preferred vehicle.

Can I book a cab for sightseeing?

Yes, you can enquire about a sightseeing trip. Share the attractions you wish to visit and your expected schedule.

Are outstation trips available?

You can enquire about one-way and round-trip travel from Kanyakumari to destinations in Tamil Nadu and Kerala. Confirm route availability before booking.

How is the cab fare calculated?

The quote may depend on vehicle type, distance, trip duration and route. Ask whether driver allowance, toll, parking, permits, taxes or minimum-kilometre terms apply.

Can I request a larger vehicle?

Yes. Mention the number of passengers and bags to enquire about an SUV, Innova, Tempo Traveller, Urbania or bus.

When is my booking confirmed?

Your booking is confirmed only after the vehicle, date, fare, inclusions and payment or advance terms are agreed directly with the travel provider.
